facts.raw_span: A 13-year-old female presented with vision loss and scotomas in the right eye
Five days prior, her classmate had directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Best corrected visual acuity (BCVA): 6/20 right eye, 20/20 left eye
Anterior segment examination: unremarkable
Fundus examination: unremarkable
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mild eminence of retinal pigment epithelium at fovea
No leakage observed
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
Decreased foveal peak P1 amplitudes in right eye
Partial restoration of ellipsoid zone, hyporeflective defect at interdigitation zone
Normal external retinal layers
